name: ordax-chatgpt
description: Connect ChatGPT to an authorized ORDAX device for grant-scoped projects, typed Computer Control, files, Git and specialized adapters.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to the ORDAX device you explicitly authorize. This ChatGPT connector exposes grant-scoped typed tools for screens and windows, desktop interaction, applications, processes, computer files and Git, managed browser tooling, and durable project continuity. Owners may optionally authorize the full Computer Control profile from ORDAX Studio; that profile still requires Full Access to be enabled locally on the device and remains bounded by Windows/UAC. Blender and Unity are specialized project adapters. The connector does not own ORDAX Studio or the Runtime, cannot mint its own grants, and cannot silently bypass local permissions.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.8 binds the connector to the canonical PostgreSQL MCP release endpoint and fails closed before producing an installable package until canonical remote actions, trusted session admission, OAuth/domain readiness and end-to-end ChatGPT-to-device verification are complete. The retired legacy D1 MCP endpoint is no longer distributable.

pt-BR.subtitle: Use o ORDAX no ChatGPT
pt-BR.description: Conecte o ChatGPT ao dispositivo autorizado pelo ORDAX. O conector usa ações tipadas e grants para tela, janelas, entrada, aplicativos, processos, arquivos, Git e continuidade. O dono pode autorizar opcionalmente o perfil completo de Computer Control no ORDAX Studio; ele só fica plenamente efetivo com Full Access local também ativo e continua limitado pelo Windows/UAC. O conector não pode criar seus próprios grants nem contornar permissões locais.
